description: A young man in a grey hoodie jogs along a suburban pavement in golden evening light. In close-up he takes a full paper grocery bag from an elderly woman's hands. Carrying a bag under each arm, he climbs the flight of steps up to her house, where the white-haired woman waits smiling by the porch railing. His hand steadies a loaded shopping trolley rolling along the pavement. Finally he stands beside her and gives a thumbs-up to the camera.

en.question: What is the young man carrying?

de.answer: Er trägt Papiertüten die Treppe hinauf.
de.question: Was trägt der junge Mann?

es.answer: Está llevando bolsas de papel escaleras arriba.
